Remark
[Identification with continuous version] ↗ thm:sobolev-embedding-w1p-supercritical 1. ch5:5.6-rem-4\group Sobolev Inequalities

For $p>n$, each $u\in W^{1,p}(U)$ is identified with the continuous version supplied by subsection 6.2.
